title: The Borrowed Language
author: Odile Thackeray
blurb: Freya Winterbourne, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
